overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, but drying fuels and warming temperatures are driving a rapid climb toward Very High by early next week.**

- Danger rises from Moderate today to High Thursday–Friday and Very High Aug 2–4, with ERC climbing from 64% to a peak of 93%.
- Today's wet, unsettled pattern (70% storm chance, gusty outflow) gives way to hot, dry, breezy NE winds later this week.
- None of the 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning is posted for the area.
- Montrose County has been under Stage 2 Fire Restrictions since July 1, and Black Canyon and Curecanti moved to Stage 2 restrictions on July 1; BLM's Tres Rios, Uncompahgre, and Gunnison field offices remain in Stage 2.
- The Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray
